resources.string: Download data using the Japanese game user ID and transfer password, then save it in a normal local account. Do not enter an email, Apple or Google password.
Official transfer authentication may affect login or transfer sessions on your existing device. The password is not saved. Review the local destination after data is downloaded.
Save as a new normal account
Select imported account for the next normal start

User ID displayed by the game
Transfer password set in the game
Verification expires within 10 minutes of starting the check.
Downloaded data is verified. Save it as a new normal account, or stop the server and choose an existing normal account in Account management before replacing it.
Saved in a normal account. Select the imported account below, switch to normal mode, then restart the game and server. Viewing accounts remain separate.
Example: Japanese account (separate from the in-game manager name)
Replace saved data in normal account %1$s. A restore point is created first, and replacement proceeds only if its checked version is unchanged. Close the game first.
Close the game, stop the server using the top controls, then try again.
Choose a normal account in Account management. Viewing accounts cannot be replaced here.
Import could not be completed. Check the transfer credentials and connection, then try again.
Enter the user ID and transfer password exactly. Leading or trailing spaces are not allowed.
The destination account changed. Refresh the account list and confirm it again.
Transfer verification expired or was cancelled. Start again by checking the transfer ID.
Official data could not be verified. Check server data preparation and the network connection.
Official account verified. Review the summary below.
Signing in to the official game
Enter a local account name. Shorten it if it is too long, and remove line breaks or slashes.
The account is saved. Temporary data cleanup is pending.
The account is saved. Refresh the local account list to view the saved entry.
Normal and viewing accounts keep separate event selections. Turning an event off preserves its progress.
Only supported events can be selected. Enabling an event starts a local 30-day window. These dates do not change the official schedule.
Changing the start time shifts the end time by the same amount.
Supported data is unavailable. Existing events can be disabled, but new ones cannot be enabled.
The settings file cannot be read. The original file and progress are preserved.
Your changes are kept; retry saving.
Check the event and dates. The end must follow the start, with a maximum duration of 366 days.
The saved state will be checked after the current settings operation finishes.
Startup checks, game connections and recent records appear together here.
All supported events start enabled for viewing accounts. You can enable or disable each event without a time limit.
Transfer may affect existing logins; passwords are not saved.
Import complete · Select the account to use.
Viewing accounts start with all events enabled without time limits.

Only files requested by the game are downloaded and kept on this device. When off, only stored files are served.
Viewing mode saves are separate from normal progress. After switching modes, restart the server and sign in again from the game title screen. Off by default.

Experimental multithreaded rendering at launch (off by default)

Fully close the game, then reopen it using the launch button in this server app. Changes are requested only when starting a new game process, not while it is running or returning from the background. Check the measured rendering mode below.
Actual mode: waiting for server and game measurements
Actual mode: waiting for a supported client to report
Actual mode: previous measurement is old; waiting for an update
Actual mode: measurement is not supported by this game.

CPU frame time: %1$s ms · GPU frame time: %2$s ms\nThese are not measurements of the displayed FPS.
CPU/GPU frame time: no recent verified measurement
Existing Unity launch arguments cannot be combined with the rendering experiment. Turn off the experiment and reopen the game.
Wait for rotation when entering or leaving an MV
When enabled, waits for screen rotation when entering or leaving an MV. On by default; applies from the next MV transition.
Rotation setting · Waiting for server and game responses
Rotation setting saved · Waiting for client confirmation
Waiting for a supported client to report the rotation setting · Update the client.
Waiting for rotation setting confirmation · If there is no response, update to a supported client.
Client confirmed the setting · Applies from the next MV transition
Could not save the rotation setting. The previous setting is preserved.
Could not read the saved rotation setting. Showing the default; changing it saves a new value.
Requires a game client that supports graphics settings. Settings can be changed while the server is running. After saving, wait for the game to confirm they have been applied.
Expand the 3D area in photography and 360° views
Renders the 3D scene beyond the default 16:9 area without zooming, cropping or stretching. Saved separately from custom graphics settings.
Original settings · Waiting for a supported game client
Settings saved · Waiting for game confirmation
Could not save settings. The previous settings are preserved.
Could not read saved settings. Showing defaults; changing a setting saves a new value.
The game confirmed that the current settings are applied.
The game confirmed that original display settings are in use.
These settings cannot be applied to the current game or screen layout.
Game received the settings · Waiting for confirmation in photography or 360° view
Could not initialize game display settings.
Install both the server APK and a game APK with graphics support. This server app does not download, modify or install the game APK.
No supported game client was found. Install the separately provided game APK first.

Original resources are stored directly in Downloads/IdolyPride/octo-cache (Android) or octo-cache-ios (iOS). All files access is required on Android 11 or later. Accounts, settings and master data stay in app storage.
Resources are kept in the selected app storage. No storage permission is needed. Use ZIP import or export to move them.

To store original resources directly in Downloads/IdolyPride, this server app needs All files access. Server start is retried when you return from permission settings. You can instead choose app storage and start without this permission.
Direct Downloads storage requires Android 11 or later. On this device, choose app storage and use the ZIP file dialog to export resources. The storage location is not changed automatically.
Could not open permission settings on this device. Choose app storage manually or check the app permissions.
The server was not started because Downloads access was not granted. Grant access or choose app storage manually.
Hide video-only MVs in live photography

After changing these settings, restart the server and sign in again from the game title screen. To change the game UI language, install the client APK for that language. Outfit sorting requires a recent supported client. Items without translations retain the original text.
Could not read saved list and language settings. Showing defaults; changing a setting saves a new value.
Could not save list and language settings. The previous values are preserved.
Downloads up to this many files at once. Applies to new download jobs.

Store original files in the selected location before starting the game. Downloading everything uses considerable data and storage. Resuming reuses verified files. ZIP import and export are optional and do not include account saves.
Resource jobs are available after starting the server.
Check the server status and any resource job in progress.
